summary_md: **ata ([@atasrb](https://x.com/atasrb/status/2115873010703864275))** benchmarks **Nanbeige4.3-33B** on DGX Spark with vLLM 0.32: NVFP4 (22 GB) 11.3 tok/s on one Spark and 20 on two, FP8 6.3 tok/s, BF16 6.8 on two Sparks; with the DFlash2 draft NVFP4 reaches 22–24 tok/s on JSON and code, and GPQA Diamond and IFEval scores are within noise across builds, with a one-command recipe ([atakann/dgx-spark-recipes](https://github.com/atakann/dgx-spark-recipes)).
